contracts: 任何适用平台行为都必须有可定位声明；缺失声明不得通过。

The dedicated assertion tests must cover the observable intent of ["python", "scripts/sc/skill_package_replay.py", "--help"] using bounded fixtures, explicit arguments and expected exit/verdict assertions. Help output, a schema document alone, or an unstarted validator cannot prove the bound acceptance. Do not invoke live backends or mutate the real repository in a negative fixture.

The dedicated assertion tests must cover the observable intent of ["python", "-m", "jsonschema", ".agents/skills/vdd-execution-plan/scripts/fixtures/profile-cases.json"] using bounded fixtures, explicit arguments and expected exit/verdict assertions. Help output, a schema document alone, or an unstarted validator cannot prove the bound acceptance. Do not invoke live backends or mutate the real repository in a negative fixture.

Each declared assertion needs a cer_assertion mapping and a meaningful independent oracle. Tests must invoke the real production entry. The plan is not a behavior observation. Keep governance/constraint failures non-authorizing; do not emit expected-red for them. Preserve all bound Given/When/Then and forbidden outcomes. No placeholder pass or synthetic RED.
